_comment: Names, prices and production for the buildings in the bottom tray.
Keys are the structure path with the category included and the trailing level-<n> dropped,
so one entry covers every upgrade tier of a building.
Costs are per resource: wood, stone, iron, gold, food, coal. Omitted resources cost nothing.
'produces' is the per-cycle income a completed building of this type adds to the owner's
stockpiles (see RtsProduction); omitted resources produce nothing.
'townHall': true marks the one building that is free and must be founded before any other;
the Town Hall has no passive production — the founder receives a small starter stockpile and
workers must be assigned to gather resources.
Mine buildings use the physical worker system: a coal mine pays 3 coal and 1 stone per worker
every 5 seconds, a quarry pays 3 stone and 1 coal, iron pays 1 iron and 1 stone every 8 seconds,
and gold pays 1 gold and 1 stone every 10 seconds. Levels 1/2/3 hold 2/4/6 workers respectively.
The Merchant brings 2 gold and 1 iron each trade cycle. A Farm feeds one assigned worker for 3
food every 5 seconds; a Villager House adds five population capacity and has no upgrades.
A structure with no entry here still shows up - it just costs nothing and takes its name from
its folder - so adding a new .nbt never hard-fails.
